_comment: Copy to config.json (or set ARTEX_CONFIG to another path). Database and skill directory settings belong here; the optional language field sets the default output language. Configure LLM and other settings through environment variables or in the app.
_comment_database: PostgreSQL connection. Precedence: ARTEX_PG_DSN environment variable > database in this file. Choose one format: (A) fill in the separate fields below, or (B) provide a complete connection string in database.dsn.
_comment_database_dsn: Format (B): replace database above with a complete DSN. When dsn is nonempty, separate connection fields are ignored.
_comment_skill_dir: Skill root directory (each subdirectory is a skill containing SKILL.md). Precedence: ARTEX_SKILL_DIR environment variable > this field > default (skills/ beside the executable). Leave empty or omit this field to use the default. Relative paths are resolved from the current working directory.
_comment_language: Default user-visible output language (en, ko, zh, es, or ja). Agent reports, summaries, conversation replies, and backend messages follow this language. Precedence: ARTEX_LANG environment variable > this field > default (en). The language selected in Settings overrides this default at runtime. Leave empty or omit this field to use English.
